headlines.title: Trump Vows Retaliation Against Iran for Houthi Attack in Red Sea
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is vowing retaliation against Iran, saying he is considering a “massive attack” after Houthi rebels struck two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea. The attack pushed international oil prices above $100 a barrel for the first time since May. NBC’s Richard Engel reports and Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker joins TODAY with political analysis.

headlines.title: House votes to end Iran war, but Senate Republicans vote to let Trump continue waging it
headlines.description: The House approved a nonbinding proposal to end the Iran war, directing President Donald Trump to remove armed forces from hostilities.

headlines.title: How the cyclospora outbreak is impacting the food industry
headlines.description: A rise in cases of cyclosporiasis is causing people to steer clear of lettuce, while forcing salad restaurants and major fast-food chains to set the record straight.

headlines.title: U.S. measles cases reach 35-year high in 2026, surpassing last year’s total
headlines.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported Friday that the United States has logged 2,318 measles cases in the first seven months of this year, surpassing last year’s total of 2,289.

headlines.title: President Trump announces new tariffs on dozens of countries
headlines.description: President Trump announced new 10% to 12.5% tariffs on 60 countries over accusations of "forced labor." Those new duties will take effect at 12:01 a.m. ET on Friday morning.

headlines.title: Outrage Boils Over in Fatal Police Shooting of Man in Wisconsin
headlines.description: Authorities have now identified the man who was shot to death by a police officer in Madison, Wisconsi, during an attempted arrest that was captured on multiple videos. It comes as protesters are demanding answers and an investigation gets underway. Warning: Some of the video is disturbing. NBC’s Shaquille Brewster reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: ‘Cockroach’ protests spread across India as leading activist ends hunger strike
headlines.description: An activist has ended his 26-day hunger strike that galvanized India’s “Cockroach” protests, turning them into one of the biggest challenges to the government.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak expands to 9 states
headlines.description: The massive, multistate outbreak of cyclosporiasis has expanded to nine states, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said Friday.

headlines.title: U.S. launches new strikes and Trump threatens ‘massive attack’ as Iran widens war
headlines.description: The United States launched a fresh barrage of strikes on Iran overnight as President Donald Trump threatened a major new escalation after Tehran opened a second front in its pressure campaign on the world economy.
